# glinet_sqm (Resource)

Manage one OpenWrt SQM queue section. The UCI section name is the stable identity.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Interface shaped by this queue.
- `name` (String) UCI SQM queue section name.

### Optional

- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `download` (Number) Download limit in kbit/s; zero leaves it unset.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this queue.
- `linklayer` (String) Link layer adaptation.
- `overhead` (Number) Per-packet overhead bytes.
- `qdisc` (String) Queueing discipline.
- `qdisc_advanced` (Boolean) Use advanced qdisc options.
- `script` (String) SQM script.
- `upload` (Number) Upload limit in kbit/s; zero leaves it unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
